headline: 3 Reasons Seagate Technology Could Be Worth a Closer Look Ahead of July 28 Earnings
summary: Seagate's hyperscaler contracts stretch well beyond this year, its free cash flow just posted a triple-digit surge, and Q4 earnings land July 28. Whether that combination justifies the current price is a question the numbers answer in a surprising way.

headline: Dear Seagate Technology Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for July 28
summary: Seagate's remarkable AI-driven rally faces another major test on July 28, when investors will look for confirmation that booming storage demand can sustain the company's extraordinary growth.
